Hi Moe,

Sorry for the very late reply, things got extremely busy on our end and I should have gotten back to you way sooner.

This message dates back several months, so your original order has almost certainly shipped by now, which means I can't add the insoles to it anymore. If you'd still like the pair of thermal insoles (Women's 9 / Men's 7), just let me know and I'll set it up so it works out best for you on shipping.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
